strategies.name: Starter-loss availability edge (spread)
strategies.hypothesis: When a club's first-string starter at a high-impact position is officially ruled out and the official team depth chart shows the replacement is a second, third or fourth string, the club's expected margin moves against it by a measurable amount.
inputs: Official NFL weekly injury report (designations, practice status) - https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg10
Official team depth charts (starter tier and listed replacement) - team official sites
strategies.method: Position-group penalty (QB 4.0, OL 1.5, WR 0.8, secondary 0.7, front seven 0.6 points of expected margin) multiplied by a depth-gap factor (2nd string x1.0, 3rd x1.5, 4th+ x2.0), subtracted from the team's model margin.

gates.evidence: Injury designations read from the official NFL weekly injury report; depth tiers read from official team depth charts. Depth charts captured this session: San Francisco 49ers, Miami Dolphins, Baltimore Ravens.

strategies.name: Net-rating mean reversion (spread)
strategies.hypothesis: A club whose current-season points differential sits far above what its previous-season differential predicts will regress; the edge is the size of the measured year-to-year reversion, not a guess.
strategies.method: Regress next-season points differential per game on prior-season points differential per game over the official panel, then fade teams whose residual is more than one standard deviation from the fitted line.

gates.evidence: All 96 team-season rows carry the official standings URL for their season.
96 team-season pairs (two year-over-year panels) were used to measure persistence; this satisfies the sample requirement for the persistence statistic itself, not for a betting edge.
Persistence is measured strictly year over year (2024->2025 and 2025->2026), so the statistic never uses a season to predict itself.
The persistence statistic is a single pre-declared test per metric; a family of threshold variants has not been tested, so no correction factor has been applied yet.
Slope standard errors and t-statistics are reported for each metric on the correlation page; the betting edge itself is not yet estimable without prices.
This strategy is the luck-control instrument: the measured share of year-to-year variance that persists is the noise floor every other strategy must beat.
Single-leg by construction; no leg correlation applies.
Two independent year-over-year panels agree; a third season would strengthen the estimate.

strategies.name: Measured home-field edge (spread)
strategies.hypothesis: The home advantage that actually exists in the data can be measured from official standings instead of assumed, and applied consistently to every originated line.
inputs: Official standings home and road records, 2024-2026 - https://www.nfl.com/standings/league/2024/REG
strategies.method: Compute the league home win rate and road win rate from the official home/road columns, convert to a logit gap, and apply a points-equivalent home adjustment; report the sensitivity of the line to the assumed margin standard deviation.

gates.evidence: Home and road records read from the official standings tables.

strategies.name: Rest differential and short week (total / spread)
strategies.hypothesis: Rest differential and a three-day week move expected scoring and expected margin in a measurable direction; both features are read directly from the official schedule.
strategies.method: For each club compute days since its previous game, flag a three-day week, and apply a points adjustment of 0.25 per rest day (capped at 1.5) plus a 1.0 point short-week penalty.

strategies.name: Low-correlation parlay builder
strategies.hypothesis: A parlay built only from legs whose measured signal correlation is small compounds independent edges; a parlay that stacks correlated legs multiplies variance instead of edge.
inputs: Measured signal correlation matrix - computed from official schedule, standings and injury sources
strategies.method: Select at most 4 legs from different games with pairwise |rho| <= 0.30, report the ticket's joint probability under independence and the effective sample size n_eff = n / (1 + (k-1) * mean_rho).

strategies.name: Backup quarterback prop suite
strategies.hypothesis: When the official injury report and official league coverage document that the starting quarterback is unavailable, the replacement quarterback's volume and efficiency props are mispriced more often than the spread, because the market prices the club's season average rather than the specific replacement.
inputs: Official NFL news confirming the quarterback change - https://www.nfl.com/news/dolphins-place-qb-malik-willis-groin-on-injured-reserve-kyle-mccord-in-line-for-first-start
Official team depth chart showing the listed quarterback order
strategies.method: Confirm the quarterback change from official sources, then model the replacement's prop baseline from official per-player usage (attempts, completions, passing yards, rushing attempts) before the game. No prop line is published until the official per-player data is captured.

strategies.name: Depth-tier prop suppression
strategies.hypothesis: Props on a player who has been pushed down the official depth chart by the return of a starter are systematically over-priced, because the public projection keeps the player in the lineup.
inputs: Official team depth charts - team official sites
strategies.method: Diff the current official depth chart against the previous published chart and the official designations, then suppress (do not take) props on any player whose tier has moved down. Requires two dated depth-chart captures per club.

strategies.name: Offensive line string depth penalty (team total)
strategies.hypothesis: An offensive line starting a second, third or fourth string at any of the five line positions costs more expected scoring than the same absence on the defensive side, because it compounds across every snap.
inputs: Official team depth charts (line positions) - team official sites
strategies.method: Apply a 1.5 point expected-margin penalty per line position whose first string is unavailable, multiplied by the depth-gap factor, and express it on the club's team total.
